verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a kill-switch concept and that server/client SDKs evaluate gates locally without a network call in under 1ms after initialization, which supports fast, deterministic flag checks, but there is no explicit documentation describing the streaming or polling mechanism that pushes config changes to already-initialized SDKs or a stated propagation latency in seconds. missing for 10: explicit description of streaming/polling update mechanism and typical propagation latency after a flag toggle, independent/hands-on confirmation that a kill switch takes effect within seconds in production.
